- **Websites** — marketing sites, landing pages, brand and event sites.
- **Web apps** — dashboards, admin panels, internal tools, customer portals.

- **SaaS platforms** — multi-tenant architecture, billing, role-based access

- **End-to-end delivery** — planning, UX, engineering, deployment and store
  publishing, without needing a separate team for handoff.

Engagement types: full-time employment, contract, and fixed-scope project work.
